attributes.name: Kixexa
attributes.powers:
Kixexa is immune to the Fire trait. All damage dealt by Kixexa is Fire damage.

If the check to defeat has the Cold trait, add 1d8.

If undefeated, each other character is dealt 1d4 Fire damage.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
